evals.name: validate_tampered_manifest
evals.description: Generate a plugin, remove a function from the manifest, and confirm --validate exits non-zero.

negative.cmd: rm -rf /tmp/eval_plugin_tamper && python3 /workspaces/G-Assist/skills/plugin-builder-skill/generator.py --name test-d --desc 'Tampered' --cmd 'a:string:cmd a' --cmd 'b:string:cmd b' --out /tmp/eval_plugin_tamper && python3 -c "import json; m=json.load(open('/tmp/eval_plugin_tamper/manifest.json')); m['functions']=m['functions'][:1]; json.dump(m, open('/tmp/eval_plugin_tamper/manifest.json','w'), indent=2)" && python3 /workspaces/G-Assist/skills/plugin-builder-skill/generator.py --validate /tmp/eval_plugin_tamper
